card.name: Capital S starting drug names in interaction lists
card.fires_on: The capital letter S that begins a new word, usually a drug name or term such as Sufentanil, Sildenafil, Sotalol, S-warfarin or Sensitive. It appears in drug-interaction tables and lists.

modes.label: New list entry
modes.description: S opens a new drug or heading right after a sentence or list item ends.

modes.label: S before a drug name
modes.description: S starts a drug name partway through an interaction list.
modes.example: Oxycodone a<< S>>ufentanil Monitor for adverse reactions

modes.label: S- in front of a hyphen
modes.description: S begins the stereoisomer label before warfarin.

card.writes: It pushes toward word pieces starting with 'ac' and away from pieces like 'oo' and 'oun', so it has little clear meaning for the next word.
card.plain: It fires on a capital S that starts a drug name or heading in interaction lists.
